meta_description: Visit Arusha National Park: Mount Meru views, Momella Lakes, walking safaris, canoeing, colobus monkeys, and easy day trips before a Serengeti safari with Tanzania Safari Magic.
excerpt: Plan an Arusha National Park day trip — Mount Meru views, Momella Lakes, walking and canoe options, wildlife highlights, and how it fits before Serengeti or Ngorongoro.

faqs.q: Is Arusha National Park worth visiting on a safari?
faqs.a: Yes as a half- or full-day add-on near town — especially for walking safaris, canoeing on Momella Lakes, colobus monkeys, and Mount Meru views. It is not a substitute for Serengeti or Ngorongoro Big Five days.

faqs.q: Can you see the Big Five in Arusha National Park?
faqs.a: No — this is not a classic Big Five park. Expect giraffe, buffalo, warthog, zebra, waterbuck, rich birdlife, and black-and-white colobus. Predators are uncommon on typical day routes.

faqs.q: How long do I need for Arusha National Park?
faqs.a: A half day covers highlights if time is tight; a full day suits walking + canoe + game drive. Mount Meru trekking is a separate multi-day product.

faqs.q: When is the best time to visit?
faqs.a: Dry months (June–October) are easiest for walks and clear Meru views. Green seasons are beautiful for birds and photography; trails can be muddier in long rains.
Most guests sleep in Arusha town or nearby lodges the night before departing for Tarangire, Ngorongoro, or Serengeti. Our Team books town hotels that fit your arrival flight and safari start.
